# Kuailu AI CRM | FAQ & User Guide

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| What is the public overseas price? | The official English pricing page currently displays USD 132 per month, billed annually, with a 7-day free trial and an included 10-user package. Final terms are confirmed in the quotation or contract. |
| Can we try the product before purchasing? | The official pricing page provides a 7-day free-trial entry. Trial availability, included functions and eligibility are subject to the current website flow. |
| Can Kuailu AI CRM connect to existing systems? | The product is positioned to connect with ERP, finance and marketing tools. Actual systems, fields, permissions and synchronization methods must be verified in an integration plan. |
| Does it support lead and customer deduplication? | Deduplication and related rules can be configured in the CRM workflow; the exact rules depend on the deployed version and configuration. |
| Can advertising leads be connected? | Connection depends on the target platform's API, account authorization, field definitions and the selected Kuailu AI CRM edition. |
| Does it support private deployment? | Deployment options depend on the selected edition, technical environment and agreed project scope. |
| How are multiple contacts and sales ownership managed? | Accounts, contacts, owners, collaborators and allocation rules can be used to manage relationships and ownership. |
| How are implementation and customization priced? | Implementation, integration, customization and deployment are scoped separately according to requirements, deliverables and the commercial agreement. |
